The Douro ( UK : / ˈ d ʊər oʊ , ˈ d ʊər uː / , US : / ˈ d ɔːr uː , ˈ d ɔːr oʊ / , [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ 3 ] [ 4 ] Portuguese: [ˈdo(w)ɾu] , Mirandese : [ˈdowɾʊ] ; Spanish : Duero [ˈdweɾo] ; Latin : Durius ) is the largest river of the Iberian Peninsula by discharge. It rises near Duruelo de la Sierra in the Spanish province of Soria , meanders briefly south, then flows generally west through the northern part of the Meseta Central in Castile and León into northern Portugal . Its largest tributary (carrying more water than the Douro at their confluence) is the right-bank Esla . [ 5 ] The Douro flows into the Atlantic Ocean at Porto , the second largest city of Portugal.
